options.name: comment
options.description: Optional. Comment for zone configuration.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Optional. I(true) to disable object. A disabled object is effectively non-existent when generating configuration.

options.name: external_primaries
options.description: Optional. DNS primaries external to BloxOne DDI. Order is not significant.

options.name: external_secondaries
options.description: DNS secondaries external to BloxOne DDI. Order is not significant.

options.name: fqdn
options.description: Zone FQDN. The FQDN supplied at creation will be converted to canonical form. Read-only after creation.

options.name: gss_tsig_enabled
options.description: I(gss_tsig_enabled) enables/disables GSS-TSIG signed dynamic updates. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the object

options.name: inheritance_sources
options.description: Optional. Inheritance configuration.

options.name: initial_soa_serial
options.description: On-create-only. SOA serial is allowed to be set when the authoritative zone is created.

options.name: internal_secondaries
options.description: Optional. BloxOne DDI hosts acting as internal secondaries. Order is not significant.

options.name: notify
options.description: Also notify all external secondary DNS servers if enabled. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: nsgs
options.description: The resource identifier.

options.name: parent
options.description: The resource identifier.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: primary_type
options.description: Primary type for an authoritative zone. Read only after creation. Allowed values: * I(external): zone data owned by an external nameserver, * I(cloud): zone data is owned by a BloxOne DDI host.

options.name: query_acl
options.description: Optional. Clients must match this ACL to make authoritative queries. Also used for recursive queries if that ACL is unset. Defaults to empty.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: Tagging specifics.

options.name: transfer_acl
options.description: Optional. Clients must match this ACL to receive zone transfers.

options.name: update_acl
options.description: Optional. Specifies which hosts are allowed to submit Dynamic DNS updates for authoritative zones of I(primary_type) I(cloud). Defaults to empty.

options.name: use_forwarders_for_subzones
options.description: Optional. Use default forwarders to resolve queries for subzones. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: view
options.description: The resource identifier.

options.name: zone_authority
options.description: Optional. ZoneAuthority.
